Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1492
Claimant:
Matthew Clark
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
09/30/2023
First notice of loss received from the claimant describing a collision at an intersection while making a left turn. The
claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been asked to provide photos and a written statement.
11/03/2023
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of the reported collision.
Nothing in the policy file suggests any damage predates the coverage start.
11/14/2023
Reviewed photos supplied by the claimant. They show the rear quarter panel and bumper damage consistent with the
described impact, and a few older scratches are visilbe that may predate this loss.
12/30/2023
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and references a left-turn collision,
though no independent witnesses were identified.
01/01/2024
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The account of how the collision happened matched the first notice of loss in every
detail, including the sequence of the turn and the point of impact.
01/07/2024
Received medical records reporting a wrist fracture. The injury type and force implied by the collision are a good fit for
this kind of impact. No prior injury to the same area is known from the claimant's history or available records.
01/13/2024
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this type of fracture. Follow-up notes are being
requested to confirm the reasons for the extended care schedule.
02/26/2024
Repair estimate reviewed against the photos and the reported impact. The vehicle damage pattern lines up with the
described collision, and the adjuster has noted the older scratches separately for the estimate.
05/06/2024
Claimant gave a second recorded statement that repeated the same account of the collision. File remains open
pending the follow-up treatment notes and final review of the photos.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
